title: Chapter 3 contingency framework, two-arm comparative architecture

design_label.carlson_arm: adapted replication of the seven Table 3 prompting strategies
design_label.rule: The Camuffo arm must never be described as a literal replication of the full Camuffo et al. appendix. It adapts the variance-aware logic to the scale of a thesis. Every departure is listed under deviations_from_camuffo.

selection_status_note: The value 'confirmed_by_user' on each model is a LEGACY TECHNICAL TOKEN, read by the gate in python/src/chapter3/execution.py and shared with the frozen single-arm config. It records only that an exact API model was pinned. It does NOT indicate the provenance of any methodological decision; those are recorded as 'researcher_approved' and 'researcher_authored_ex_ante' in the definition files.

counterbalancing.s_is_a_pure_replicate: All S samples of a cell share one label order and one byte-identical payload. S measures variation between independent calls at an unchanged configuration; it is not made robust to the label order.
counterbalancing.both_orders_in_every_block: Within each item x model block, the three paraphrases carry both orders, two against one.
counterbalancing.minority_rotates: The paraphrase holding the minority order rotates deterministically through P1, P2 and P3 as the block rank advances, so each paraphrase receives both orders evenly across items and models.
counterbalancing.balanced_within_scope: Perfectly balanced when the number of blocks is even; apart by at most one cell otherwise.
counterbalancing.interpretation: The label order is an interface factor, counterbalanced across cells and recorded separately. P measures wording variation; S measures call-to-call variation at a fixed configuration.

camuffo.samples_rationale: S = 3 is a feasibility adaptation driven by cost. It is BELOW the values typically indicated by Camuffo et al. and must be reported as an adaptation, not as the recommended design.

counterbalancing.reason: The seven prompts are canonical transcriptions of Table 3 and are never reordered.

aggregation.rule: At every level, at least two valid contributions are required. With three valid contributions the majority decides. With two valid contributions that agree, their label decides. With two valid contributions that disagree, the result is null. With one or zero valid contributions, the result is null. Parse errors and missing outputs are never substituted.
aggregation.rationale_for_the_minimum: A single surviving call is not a majority of anything. Letting it decide would make the annotation of the worst-covered cells rest on whichever call happened to return a parseable answer.

missingness.no_imputation: A missing or unparsable label is never imputed, defaulted or resampled.

aggregation.tie_note: All three levels have odd cardinality when complete, so a tie can arise only from missingness. The rule handles that case explicitly rather than choosing a silent default.
aggregation.comparison_interpretation: The primary comparison between the two arms is a comparison of two complete methodological approaches. It is NOT a causal identification of the isolated effect of aggregation.
aggregation.robustness_check: pooled majority over all 27 outputs, secondary only

primary.rationale: Each arm is decoded as its own source design prescribes: 0 for the Carlson replication, as the paper reports, and 1 for the Camuffo arm so that the S replicates are informative rather than near-deterministic.
primary.when_control_unavailable: Do NOT simulate the parameter. Omit it, let the provider's native default apply, and record temperature_control as 'unavailable'.
primary.verification_rule: OpenRouter endpoint metadata is not evidence about the first-party API contracts. temperature_verification_source must name what was actually checked.
primary.interpretation: The primary comparison is a comparison of two complete methodological approaches. It is NOT a causal identification of the isolated effect of aggregation: prompt set, sampling, temperature and aggregation differ together by design.

secondary_diagnostic.purpose: Swap the two temperatures to see how much of the arm difference tracks decoding rather than design.
constraints: Separate manifest and separate result files.
Not included in the primary call counts.
Never executed automatically; it requires its own explicit instruction.

recorded_fields.temperature_requested: What the design asked for. Null while the policy is undecided.
recorded_fields.temperature_accepted: What the provider reported accepting, when it reports it.
recorded_fields.temperature_parameter_sent: The parameter actually placed on the wire, or null if none was sent.
recorded_fields.temperature_verification_source: Where the availability claim comes from, for example 'openrouter_endpoint_metadata' or 'first_party_api_contract'.
recorded_fields.native_default_observable: Whether the provider's own default is observable. False means the effective temperature is unknown and must be reported as such.

temperature_policy.reasoning_policy: Provider-native reasoning stays disabled wherever technically possible, independently of this decision.

deviations_from_camuffo.deviation: S = 3, a feasibility adaptation driven by cost, below the values typically indicated by Camuffo et al.
No autonomous audit set has been constructed so far. The 250 campaigns carry the paper's human labels and serve as the benchmark, not as an independent audit.
The rubric was reconstructed ex ante from the published construct definition and examples. The original human codebook is not available in the materials we hold.
Temperature control depends on provider capability and is not guaranteed to be available on every route.
max_output_tokens = 1 for the Camuffo arm is proposed and subject to the smoke test. It is a transport cap, not a semantic guarantee.
Label-order counterbalancing is implemented in the Camuffo arm only. The Carlson prompts are canonical transcriptions and are never reordered.
The pilot is 12 items across every DeepSeek configuration, rather than the 20x1x1 pilot illustrated in the Camuffo et al. appendix.

sharing.rule: No prompt is shared between the arms. Sharing may be introduced only if prompt, system message, data, parameters and response contract are identical. The Camuffo rubric must never be weakened to manufacture a shared anchor.
sharing.detection: The generator computes payload_sha256 for every call and reports collisions between arms as candidates, without using them.

execution.max_output_tokens_note: Set per arm, not globally: 1 for Camuffo, 16 for Carlson. See arms.*.max_output_tokens. A cap is a transport limit, never a semantic guarantee of the output format; the strict binary parser stays the authoritative check.
execution.finish_reason_note: Required for the Camuffo arm. If the one-token cap prevents a provider from emitting a valid label, the failure must surface as a truncation, not be silently absorbed as a parse_error. The configuration is never adjusted automatically: the smoke test reports the failure and proposes the smallest reliable value.

sample_slot_policy.technical_failure: No completion received. A bounded technical retry on the same task and the same sample_index is permitted.
sample_slot_policy.parse_error: A completion was received but is not exactly '0' or '1' after stripping. It is never retried automatically, it consumes its planned slot, and the original output is preserved verbatim.
sample_slot_policy.no_automatic_replacement: A missing label is never replaced by a new call. Resampling only the format violations would condition the realised sample on format compliance.
sample_slot_policy.remediation: not_implemented; any future remediation preserves the original, is explicitly marked, and stays out of the primary analysis unless a pre-registered decision admits it.

execution.api_keys: Read from environment variables only. No key or credential appears in this file or any configuration file.

smoke.description: One call per template. Used to prove assembly, never for analysis.

pilot_deepseek.description: Single-model pilot on the cheapest route.

pilot_full.description: Three-model pilot on the same 12 items.

generation_gates.behaviour_when_blocked: The generator raises and names every unmet gate. It never emits a partial or placeholder manifest.
generation_gates.fixtures_allowed_while_blocked: Synthetic-fixture generation is permitted while gates are open, because it touches neither the real dataset nor any frozen path. It is refused for the real dataset.
generation_gates.immutability: A frozen manifest is never overwritten, with or without a flag. Any change to config, catalog or dataset produces a new version directory or a new study_id, preserving the previous one.

A two-of-three majority is still well defined, but a cell reduced to two or fewer valid labels needs an explicit rule. Not decided; must not be resolved silently.
